evidence.note: Si4435DDY is SO-8 (8-pin); AOD4185 is DPAK-3 (3-pin). Footprint and land pattern are completely different.
SO-8 has separate gate/source/drain on different pins; DPAK consolidates and uses the tab as drain.
Si4435DDY VDS=-30V; AOD4185 VDS=-40V. Voltage rating alone is acceptable but does not fix the package mismatch.
Si4435DDY ID=-8.5A; AOD4185 ID=-12A. Current rating alone is acceptable.
Both specified at VGS=-10V (22 mOhm vs 35 mOhm). Si4435DDY has lower RDS_on, but neither value alone resolves the package mismatch.
Both P-channel, logic-level compatible at VGS=-4.5V with derated RDS_on.
Si4435DDY Qg=11 nC; AOD4185 Qg=12 nC — within 10%.
Si4435DDY Rtheta_ja=50 C/W; AOD4185 Rtheta_ja=75 C/W — AOD4185 is thermally weaker in still air.

verification_notes: Package and pinout mismatch makes direct substitution impossible without board rework. NOT_RECOMMENDED for direct swap.
